fairy-tail-movie-2.summary: Dragon Cry is a magical staff said to hold the rage and grief of long-dead dragons, and it has been stolen from the kingdom of Fiore by Zash Caine, a traitor who has escaped across the sea to Stella, a small island kingdom. Fearing what it could do in the wrong hands, Fiore's king quietly asks the wizard guild Fairy Tail for help. Natsu Dragneel, Lucy Heartfilia, Happy, Gray, Erza and Wendy travel to Stella, where they find the staff is tied to more than one person's plans. A-1 Pictures released the film in 2017, based on Hiro Mashima's Fairy Tail, with Mashima serving as chief producer. Contains action violence.

black-butler-book-of-the-atlantic.summary: Earl Ciel Phantomhive, who investigates the strangest crimes in Victorian England for the queen, hears rumours of a secret society claiming it can bring the dead back to life. Its next meeting is to take place aboard the Campania, a luxury liner crossing the Atlantic, so Ciel books passage along with his demon butler Sebastian Michaelis. His cheerful fiancée Elizabeth and her family happen to be on the same ship, which makes his work harder, and the society's experiments turn out to be far more dangerous than rumours suggested. A-1 Pictures released the film in 2017, directed by Noriyuki Abe and adapting the luxury liner arc of Yana Toboso's manga. Contains graphic violence and gore.

nisemonogatari.summary: Koyomi Araragi is a high school student who survived a vampire attack and has since helped several girls troubled by apparitions. This entry turns to his two younger sisters, Karen and Tsukihi, who call themselves the Fire Sisters and play at being heroes of justice around town. When Karen goes after a con man named Deishu Kaiki, someone with a history with Koyomi's girlfriend Hitagi Senjougahara, she ends up out of her depth, and later Tsukihi's own secret comes to light. Shaft produced the 11 episodes in 2012, adapting NisiOisiN's light novel. It relies heavily on long conversations. Contains frequent fan service and sexual content, including scenes involving Koyomi's sisters.

barakamon.summary: Seishu Handa is a young, talented and very proud calligrapher. When an elderly exhibition director calls his prize-winning work unoriginal, Seishu punches him, and his father sends him away to the Goto Islands off Kyushu to calm down and reflect. In a small village where everyone knows everyone, his hopes of quiet concentration fall apart almost at once, thanks to Naru, an energetic local girl who treats his house as her playground, and a stream of curious kids and neighbours. Kinema Citrus produced the 12 episodes in 2014, adapting Satsuki Yoshino's manga. It is a gentle comedy about rural life and finding his own style.

boku-no-hero-academia-the-movie.summary: During summer break, Izuku Midoriya travels with All Might to I-Island, a floating city built for research on Quirks, the superpowers most people in the world are born with. They are there for a huge technology expo, where All Might reunites with his old friend, the scientist David Shield, and Izuku meets David's daughter Melissa, who has no Quirk of her own. Several of Izuku's classmates turn up too. When a group of villains seizes the island's security system and takes everyone hostage, the students have to act. Bones released this original film in 2018, directed by Kenji Nagasaki and based on Kohei Horikoshi's manga. Contains action violence.

steins-gate-0.summary: Steins;Gate 0 follows a different timeline from the end of Steins;Gate. Rintarou Okabe, the self-styled mad scientist, could not save his friend Kurisu Makise, and the failure has left him withdrawn. He has given up his old persona and tries to live as an ordinary university student. Then, at a lecture, he meets Maho Hiyajo, a researcher who worked with Kurisu, and learns about Amadeus, an artificial intelligence that can recreate a person from their memories, including a version of Kurisu. Okabe is asked to help test it. White Fox produced the 23 episodes in 2018, adapting the visual novel. Deals with trauma, grief and some violence.

kamisama-hajimemashita-2.summary: Nanami Momozono is a high school girl who became the god of a run-down shrine, served by Tomoe, a fox spirit who acts as her familiar and, increasingly, the person she cares about. In the second season she receives an invitation to Izumo for the Divine Assembly, a yearly gathering of gods, and goes with the snake familiar Mizuki while Tomoe stays behind and disguises himself as her at school. Nanami also hopes to learn where the shrine's former god, Mikage, has gone. Later she is pulled into trouble among the tengu of Mount Kurama, and Tomoe's past begins to resurface. TMS Entertainment produced the 12 episodes in 2015, adapting Julietta Suzuki's manga.

one-piece-episode-of-east-blue-luffy-to-.summary: This TV special retells the opening chapter of One Piece in a single feature with new animation. As a child, Monkey D. Luffy idolises the pirate Red-Haired Shanks and accidentally eats a Devil Fruit that turns his body to rubber. Years later he sets out to sea to become King of the Pirates and gathers his first crew in the East Blue: the swordsman Roronoa Zoro, the navigator and thief Nami, the storyteller and sniper Usopp, and the cook Sanji. Toei Animation aired the special in 2017 on Fuji TV, based on Eiichiro Oda's manga. It condenses many TV episodes, so it works as a recap for viewers who know them. Contains action violence.
one-piece-episode-of-east-blue-luffy-to-.notes: Newly animated condensed retelling of the East Blue saga rather than a clip compilation; kept and labelled as a retelling.

high-school-dxd-new.summary: Issei Hyodo is a lecherous high school student who was brought back to life as a devil serving Rias Gremory, the beautiful leader of his school's Occult Research Club. In the second season, the club's usually calm swordsman Yuto Kiba starts acting strangely, and Issei learns why: Kiba survived a brutal experiment linked to the church's holy swords and wants revenge. Two sword-wielding girls sent by the church arrive in town, and a dangerous fallen angel begins a plot that threatens the uneasy balance between devils, angels and fallen angels. TNK produced the 12 episodes in 2013, adapting Ichiei Ishibumi's light novels. Contains heavy fan service, nudity, sexual content and violence.

boku-no-hero-academia-all-might-rising-t.summary: All Might is the Symbol of Peace, the hero whose smile reassures an entire society where most people are born with superpowers called Quirks. This short release is made up of two pieces that accompanied the home video edition of the 2018 film My Hero Academia: Two Heroes. The first is an animated version of a one-shot manga about All Might's younger days and how he rose to become the number one hero. The second is a brief epilogue to the film's story in a picture drama format, a mostly still-image presentation with voice acting. Bones produced both in 2019. Best watched after the film. Contains mild action.
boku-no-hero-academia-all-might-rising-t.notes: MAL, Kitsu and AniList share one blurb describing the two bonus pieces; the content is described only at that level.

steins-gate-fuka-ryouiki-no-deja-vu.summary: This film is set a year after the events of the Steins;Gate TV series. Kurisu Makise, a young neuroscientist, returns to Akihabara from America and reunites with Rintarou Okabe and the friends of his tiny Future Gadget Laboratory. The visit is cut short when Okabe starts experiencing sudden flashes of other timelines, an after-effect of his earlier time travel. The symptoms grow worse until he disappears from the world, and Kurisu is left as the only one who remembers him. White Fox released the film in 2013 as a follow-up to the TV anime based on the visual novel by 5pb. and Nitroplus. Best watched after the series.

sword-art-online-alicization.summary: Kazuto 'Kirito' Kirigaya takes a part-time job testing the Soul Translator, a new full-dive machine developed by a company called Rath that connects directly to a person's mind. Then he wakes up in a vast fantasy forest with no memory of how he got there or how to log out. He befriends Eugeo, a young woodcutter whose childhood friend Alice was taken away years earlier, and the two set off toward the distant Central Cathedral to find her. A-1 Pictures produced these 24 episodes from 2018 to 2019, covering the opening half of Reki Kawahara's Alicization storyline. Contains violence, gore and an attempted sexual assault.

spice-and-wolf-ii.summary: Kraft Lawrence, a travelling merchant in a medieval-style world, continues north with Holo, a centuries-old wolf deity who looks like a young woman with ears and a tail, as she searches for her lost homeland of Yoitsu. In a busy festival town, a young fish merchant takes a liking to Holo and makes Lawrence wonder how long she will stay with him. Later they become involved in risky trading schemes in another city while gathering clues about Holo's past. Brain's Base and Marvy Jack produced the 12 episodes in 2009, adapting Isuna Hasekura's light novels. It focuses on economics, conversations and the relationship between the two leads. Contains brief nudity.

kono-subarashii-sekai-ni-shukufuku-wo-mo.summary: Kazuma Satou's adventuring party includes Megumin, a member of the Crimson Demons, a clan of wizards famous for powerful magic and dramatic poses. When Yunyun, Megumin's self-appointed rival and fellow clanswoman, receives an alarming letter suggesting their home village is in danger from the Demon King's army, she sets off to help, and the rest of the party follows along. In the Crimson Demon village, Kazuma meets Megumin's eccentric family and neighbours, and discovers that the threat is not quite what anyone expected. J.C.Staff released the film in 2019, adapting the fifth volume of Natsume Akatsuki's light novels. Contains comedic fan service.

jojo-s-bizarre-adventure-part-5-vento-au.summary: In Naples in 2001, where the police are corrupt and a mafia-like gang called Passione controls the streets and the drug trade, 15-year-old Giorno Giovanna lives as a small-time hustler. He has an unusual family tie to the Joestar bloodline and a Stand that can bring life to objects, and he dreams of becoming a 'Gang-Star' so that he can take over the gang and clean up the city. To do that he first has to join Passione, and a run-in with the gang member Bruno Bucciarati gives him his chance. David Production produced the 39 episodes from 2018 to 2019, adapting Part 5 of Hirohiko Araki's manga. Contains graphic violence and drug themes.

k-on-season-2.summary: Yui Hirasawa, Mio Akiyama, Ritsu Tainaka and Tsumugi Kotobuki are now third-years at their girls' high school, and their Light Music Club band, Ho-kago Tea Time, still spends more time drinking tea and eating cake than rehearsing. Their only junior member is the hard-working guitarist Azusa Nakano, and the seniors realise she will be alone once they graduate, so they try, not very effectively, to recruit new members. The season follows their final school year, including a class trip, the school festival and university entrance exams. Kyoto Animation produced the 26 episodes in 2010, adapting Kakifly's four-panel manga. It is a gentle slice-of-life comedy.

shingeki-no-kyojin-the-final-season-part.summary: Part 2 of The Final Season picks up immediately after Part 1. The long conflict between the island of Paradis, home of the Eldians who can turn into Titans, and the nation of Marley across the sea has reached a breaking point. Eren Yeager, now acting on his own and alongside his half-brother Zeke, has set events in motion that leave his former friends in the Survey Corps unsure what he really intends, while soldiers from both sides are forced to rethink who their enemies are. MAPPA produced the 12 episodes in 2022, adapting Hajime Isayama's manga. Contains graphic violence, gore, war atrocities and many character deaths.

dr-stone-two.summary: Thousands of years after a mysterious light turned every human into stone, the teenage genius Senku Ishigami is rebuilding civilisation from scratch with the villagers of Ishigami Village. Standing against him is Tsukasa Shishio, a powerful fighter who wants to revive only the young and strong and keep the old world's corruption buried. As winter ends, both sides prepare for open conflict, and Senku's Kingdom of Science tries to win with inventions rather than bloodshed, starting with a plan to build working phones. TMS Entertainment produced these 11 episodes in 2021, adapting the manga by Riichiro Inagaki and Boichi. Contains some action violence.

black-butler-book-of-murder.summary: At Queen Victoria's request, the young Earl Ciel Phantomhive hosts a grand dinner party at his country manor for a group of distinguished guests, along with Arthur, a struggling young writer who has been invited almost by accident. As a storm cuts the house off from the outside world, one of the guests is found dead, suspicion falls on Ciel himself, and the guests have to work out who among them is responsible before anyone else is killed. Ciel's demon butler Sebastian Michaelis is, as always, close at hand. A-1 Pictures released this two-part story, adapting the manga's manor murder arc by Yana Toboso, first in Japanese cinemas in 2014. Contains violence and murder.

overlord-ii.summary: Ainz Ooal Gown, a skeletal sorcerer who was once a player named Momonga, rules the Great Tomb of Nazarick in a world that resembles his old online game but is now real. Still exploring its rules, he sends his loyal guardian Cocytus to subjugate the lizardmen tribes living near a lake, and the season follows the tribes as they unite to resist. In the human kingdom of Re-Estize, meanwhile, Nazarick's butler Sebas becomes involved with the capital's criminal underworld. Madhouse produced the 13 episodes in 2018, adapting Kugane Maruyama's light novels. It shows the story largely from the side of the villains. Contains graphic violence and disturbing scenes, including abuse.

chuunibyou-demo-koi-ga-shitai-ren.summary: Yuta Togashi spent middle school pretending to be a dark hero and now wants to forget it, but his girlfriend Rikka Takanashi still fully believes in her own fantasy persona, complete with an eyepatch and imaginary powers. In the second season, Rikka moves into Yuta's home as a new school year begins, yet the two are not sure how to make their relationship feel romantic. Their club friends carry on as before, and then Satone Shichimiya, a girl from Yuta's middle school days with fantasies of her own, reappears. Kyoto Animation produced the 12 episodes in 2014, adapting Torako's light novel. It is a romantic comedy with occasional drama.

black-lagoon-the-second-barrage.summary: Rokuro 'Rock' Okajima, a former Japanese office worker, now works for the Lagoon Company, a small crew of mercenary smugglers based in Roanapur, a lawless port city in Thailand, alongside the gun-crazy Revy. In The Second Barrage, a pair of child killers arrive in Roanapur and set the local crime syndicates against each other. Later, Rock goes back to Japan with Revy on a job for the Russian mafia, where he is pulled into a yakuza dispute and confronts what his old home means to him. Madhouse produced the 12 episodes in 2006, adapting Rei Hiroe's manga. Contains extreme violence, violence involving children, and strong language.

overlord-iii.summary: Ainz Ooal Gown, the undead master of Nazarick, a vast underground tomb, and his loyal guardians are ready to move beyond quiet groundwork in a world they intend to dominate. This season begins with daily life inside Nazarick, then follows a group of human adventurers hired to explore the tomb, unaware of what lives there. Meanwhile, the human village of Carne and its young leader Enri face threats of their own, and Ainz's plans eventually bring him into open conflict with a human kingdom. Madhouse produced the 13 episodes in 2018, adapting Kugane Maruyama's light novels. Contains graphic violence, gore and mass killing.

re-zero-kara-hajimeru-isekai-seikatsu-2.summary: Subaru Natsuki was pulled into a fantasy world where his only power is Return by Death: when he dies, time rewinds to an earlier point, and he alone remembers what happened. The second season begins straight after the first, as Subaru and the half-elf Emilia face the heavy cost of their recent battles. Their search for answers leads them to the Sanctuary, a hidden settlement tied to their patron Roswaal, where Emilia must take on a series of trials and Subaru meets Echidna, the Witch of Greed. White Fox produced these 13 episodes in 2020, the first half of the season, adapting Tappei Nagatsuki's light novels. Contains graphic violence and disturbing psychological themes.

toaru-kagaku-no-railgun.summary: Academy City is a walled city of students where science is used to awaken psychic powers, and only seven people have reached the top rank, Level 5. Third among them is Mikoto Misaka, a middle schooler at an elite girls' school who controls electricity and fire coins at high speed, a move that earned her the nickname Railgun. She spends her days with her devoted roommate Kuroko Shirai, a member of the student security force Judgment, and friends Kazari Uiharu and Ruiko Saten, until a rumoured ability-boosting device starts causing trouble. J.C.Staff produced the 24 episodes from 2009 to 2010, based on the spin-off manga of Kazuma Kamachi's A Certain Magical Index. Contains action and some fan service.

gintama-2015-tv.summary: Gintoki Sakata, Shinpachi Shimura and Kagura run Yorozuya, an odd-jobs business in an alternate Edo ruled by alien invaders, and as usual they are broke. Gintama° opens when Gintoki, staggering home drunk, is handed a strange clock-shaped device by the injured crew member of a crashed alien ship, and then breaks it, freezing time across the city. That comedy story gives way to the series' usual mix of parodies and running jokes, followed by some of its longest and most serious storylines, involving the shogun, the Shinsengumi and old enemies. Bandai Namco Pictures produced the 51 episodes from 2015 to 2016, adapting Hideaki Sorachi's manga. Contains crude humour and violence.

dragon-ball-super.summary: Some years have passed since the battle with Majin Buu, life on Earth is calm, and Goku is working as a farmer, though he would much rather be training. Then Beerus, the cat-like God of Destruction, wakes from a long sleep after dreaming about a being called the Super Saiyan God, and comes looking for a fight. His visit introduces Goku and Vegeta to the gods who oversee the universe, and to the existence of other universes with fighters of their own. Old enemies also return. Toei Animation produced the 131 episodes from 2015 to 2018, with story by Akira Toriyama. Later arcs include tournaments between fighters from different universes. Contains action violence.

seishun-buta-yarou-wa-yumemiru-shoujo-no.summary: Sakuta Azusagawa is a high school student who has helped several girls affected by Adolescence Syndrome, strange phenomena tied to teenage anxieties, and is now happily dating the actress Mai Sakurajima. His life is shaken when Shoko Makinohara, the young woman who was his first crush, reappears as an adult, even though he also knows a younger Shoko who is still in middle school and seriously ill. Sakuta has to work out how both can exist and what that means for his future with Mai. CloverWorks released the film in 2019, a sequel to Rascal Does Not Dream of Bunny Girl Senpai based on Hajime Kamoshida's light novels. Deals with serious illness and death.

evangelion-2-0-you-can-not-advance.summary: The second film of the Rebuild of Evangelion series continues the reworked story of Shinji Ikari, a withdrawn fourteen-year-old who pilots the giant Evangelion Unit-01 for the agency Nerv against monstrous beings called Angels. Shinji and the quiet pilot Rei Ayanami are joined by two newcomers: the proud, combative Asuka Langley Shikinami and Mari Illustrious Makinami, a pilot who is not part of the original TV series. As the Angel attacks grow more dangerous, Shinji starts to connect with the people around him, including his distant father. Studio Khara released the film in 2009, with Hideaki Anno as writer and chief director. Contains violence, gore and some disturbing imagery.

tensei-shitara-slime-datta-ken-2.summary: Satoru Mikami was killed in Tokyo and reborn as a slime in a fantasy world, taking the name Rimuru Tempest and becoming leader of a growing nation of monsters. After his time teaching children in a human city, Rimuru returns to Tempest, where talks with Eurazania, a powerful neighbouring kingdom of beastfolk, are under way. The success of Tempest as a place where monsters and humans trade peacefully also draws suspicion from nearby human kingdoms and a powerful religious order, and Rimuru is soon forced to make difficult choices about protecting his people. Eight Bit produced these 12 episodes in 2021, the first part of the second season, based on Fuse's light novels. Contains violence.

owari-no-seraph-nagoya-kessen.summary: In a world where a virus killed most adults and vampires now rule over the surviving children, Yuichiro Hyakuya serves in the Japanese Imperial Demon Army, determined to wipe out vampires. He has just found his childhood friend Mikaela again, but Mikaela is now a vampire himself and wants to rescue Yuichiro from an army he believes is using him. Yuichiro refuses to abandon his squad, which is sent to Nagoya on a large operation against powerful vampire nobles, a mission that reveals more about the army's own goals. Wit Studio produced these 12 episodes in 2015, the second cour of the Seraph of the End anime based on Takaya Kagami's manga. Contains graphic violence and gore.

psycho-pass-2.summary: In a near-future Japan, the Sibyl System scans citizens' minds to measure their likelihood of committing crimes, and the police act on its readings. Akane Tsunemori, now an experienced inspector, still enforces Sibyl's judgements even as she questions them. She works with new enforcers and a junior inspector, Mika Shimotsuki, who trusts the system completely. A string of incidents points to Kirito Kamui, a criminal whom Sibyl appears unable to detect, and who seems set on challenging the system itself. Tatsunoko Production produced the 11 episodes in 2014, a direct sequel to the original Psycho-Pass, with scripts led by Tow Ubukata. Contains graphic violence, gore and disturbing scenes.

hunter-x-hunter-greed-island-final.summary: This OVA series continues the 2003 Greed Island story. Gon Freecss and his friend Killua are inside Greed Island, a deadly game created partly by Gon's absent father Ging, where players must collect rare cards to clear it and injuries are real. They are training under Biscuit Krueger, a veteran Hunter who looks like a young girl but is far older and much tougher than she seems, in order to master Nen, the energy Hunters use in combat. As their skills grow, they encounter rival players, some of whom hunt others for their cards. Nippon Animation released these 14 episodes in 2004, based on Yoshihiro Togashi's manga. Contains violence.

steins-gate-egoistic-poriomania.summary: This one-episode special takes place a few months after the Steins;Gate TV series. Self-styled mad scientist Rintarou Okabe and his friends from the Future Gadget Laboratory travel to the United States with Faris NyanNyan, who is competing in a tournament for the card game Rai-Net. There they meet up with Kurisu Makise, a young neuroscientist and lab member, who has been having fragmented recollections that do not match her own life. The episode is mostly a lighter, comedic follow-up focused on the characters' friendships. White Fox produced it in 2012. Best watched after the TV series.

sword-art-online-ordinal-scale.summary: Four years have passed since the Sword Art Online incident, and in 2026 people have turned to the Augma, a wearable augmented reality device that overlays games on the real world while players stay fully conscious. Its most popular game, Ordinal Scale, rewards players for fighting in city streets. Kazuto 'Kirito' Kirigaya, a survivor of the old death game, is not keen on it, but his girlfriend Asuna and their friends join in. When bosses from the original Sword Art Online start appearing in the game and some players begin losing their memories, Kirito investigates. A-1 Pictures released this original film in 2017, directed by Tomohiko Ito and based on Reki Kawahara's light novels. Contains action violence.

kizumonogatari-part-1-tekketsu-hen.summary: Over the spring break before his third year of high school, Koyomi Araragi is a loner with almost no friends. He has a chance conversation with Tsubasa Hanekawa, the top student in his year, who mentions a rumour about a blonde vampire roaming town. That night he finds a vampire lying in the street, bleeding and missing her limbs, who begs him to save her by giving her his blood. His decision changes his life. Shaft released this film in 2016, the first of three films, with Akiyuki Shinbo and Tatsuya Oishi directing, adapting NisiOisiN's light novel, a prequel to Bakemonogatari. Contains graphic gore and some fan service.

high-school-dxd-born.summary: Issei Hyodo, a lecherous high school student reborn as a devil, is the host of the Red Dragon Emperor, a powerful dragon spirit sealed in his arm. After recent fights, Rias Gremory, head of the Occult Research Club and Issei's master, realises her group is not strong enough, so the club spends summer break training in the Underworld under the fallen angel Azazel. New rivals and Rating Games, official battles between devil families, await, and an enemy from Norse mythology arrives to threaten a peace meeting. TNK produced the 12 episodes in 2015, adapting Ichiei Ishibumi's light novels. Contains heavy fan service, nudity, sexual content and violence.

the-melancholy-of-haruhi-suzumiya-2009.summary: Kyon is a sceptical high school student who has been roped into the SOS Brigade, a club his restless classmate Haruhi Suzumiya founded to hunt for aliens, time travellers and espers. The other members, timid Mikuru Asahina, silent bookworm Yuki Nagato and ever-smiling Itsuki Koizumi, are hiding more than they let on, and keeping Haruhi from getting bored has become Kyon's unofficial job. This entry covers the 14 new episodes Kyoto Animation made for the 2009 rebroadcast, which aired in story order alongside the 2006 episodes: a Tanabata night, a summer break that keeps repeating, and the brigade's attempt to film a movie for the school festival. The source is Nagaru Tanigawa's light novels.
the-melancholy-of-haruhi-suzumiya-2009.notes: Kitsu entry counts only the 14 new 2009 episodes; MAL 4382 lists the full 28-episode rebroadcast that contains them.

ghost-in-the-shell-stand-alone-complex.summary: In a near-future Japan where people can swap their bodies for cybernetic ones and link their brains straight to the network, Public Security Section 9 is a small, elite unit handling cyber-crime, terrorism and politically sensitive cases. Major Motoko Kusanagi, a full-body cyborg, leads the team in the field alongside the hulking Batou and Togusa, an ex-detective with almost no implants, while Chief Daisuke Aramaki deals with the politicians above them. Many episodes are standalone cases, but the season keeps coming back to the Laughing Man, a near-mythical hacker tied to an unsolved corporate crime from years before. Production I.G made the 26 episodes in 2002 and 2003, directed by Kenji Kamiyama from Masamune Shirow's manga.

ao-no-exorcist-2.summary: Rin Okumura is a hot-headed teenager who carries the blue flames of Satan and is training to become an exorcist at True Cross Academy, where his twin brother Yukio is one of the teachers. Now that his fellow trainees know whose son he is, most of them keep their distance, and Rin has to prove he can master his flames. Then the Impure King's left eye, a dangerous relic of a powerful demon kept in the academy's vault, is stolen. When someone also goes after the right eye, held in Kyoto, Rin and the others are sent there to find out who is behind it. A-1 Pictures made this 12-episode second season in 2017, based on Kazue Kato's manga.

log-horizon-2.summary: Six months have passed since thousands of players were trapped inside the online fantasy game Elder Tale. The city of Akiba has found order under the Round Table Council, an alliance of guilds that Shiroe, a quiet and calculating strategist, helped bring together, and the noble Princess Raynesia now lives there. With winter coming, the council faces new problems and the players start asking what they actually want from this world. Shiroe decides to leave the city with his friend Naotsugu to chase answers and resources, while the rest of his guild, Log Horizon, faces challenges of its own. Studio Deen took over from Satelight for this 25-episode season in 2014 and 2015, adapting Mamare Touno's novels.

tsurezure-children.summary: Tsurezure Children is a collection of short romantic comedy sketches about high school students who are only beginning to work out what to do with a crush. Instead of following one couple, it moves between a large cast: people who rehearse a confession and then freeze, a boy who can never tell whether a classmate's declarations of love are jokes, shy pairs whose low confidence keeps getting in the way, and new couples who have no idea how to act once they are actually dating. Each episode cuts between several of these pairs, with small misunderstandings and awkward silences doing most of the work. Studio Gokumi adapted Toshiya Wakabayashi's four-panel manga into 12 short episodes in 2017.

akagami-no-shirayuki-hime-2.summary: Shirayuki is a red-haired herbalist who fled the kingdom of Tanbarun and now works in Clarines as an apprentice herbalist for the royal court. There she grew close to Zen, the kingdom's second prince, and the two have now admitted how they feel about each other. This second season follows what that means in practice, in a court where a commoner beside a prince draws attention. First, Zen's elder brother Izana sends Shirayuki back to Tanbarun for a seven-day visit at the invitation of Prince Raji, the once-arrogant royal who drove her away, and a stranger there takes an unexplained interest in her. Bones adapted Sorata Akizuki's manga into 12 episodes in 2016. It is a gentle fantasy romance.

violet-evergarden-movie.summary: Several years after the war, Violet Evergarden is one of the best-known Auto Memory Dolls at the CH Postal Company in Leiden, writing letters for people who struggle to put their feelings into words. Telephones are spreading, but Violet still cannot let go of Gilbert, the officer she served under as a child soldier, or the last words he left her. When a seriously ill boy named Yuris asks her to write letters for his family, and a letter with no clear sender turns up in the post office's storeroom, both stir up feelings she has kept to herself. Kyoto Animation released this sequel to the TV series in 2020. It deals with grief and illness.

bungou-stray-dogs-3.summary: In this version of Yokohama, people with supernatural abilities named after famous writers work for the Armed Detective Agency or for its rival, the criminal Port Mafia. Season three opens years in the past, when Osamu Dazai was a teenage Port Mafia recruit and had to work with Chuuya Nakahara, the hot-tempered leader of a street gang called the Sheep, to investigate rumours linked to a mysterious explosion and the old Mafia boss. In the present, Atsushi Nakajima's Agency is enjoying a truce with the Mafia when a new threat appears: Fyodor Dostoevsky and his group, the Rats in the House of the Dead. Bones produced the 12 episodes in 2019 from Kafka Asagiri and Sango Harukawa's manga.

cowboy-bebop-tengoku-no-tobira.summary: The film catches up with the bounty hunters of the spaceship Bebop: laid-back Spike Spiegel, ex-cop Jet Black, gambler Faye Valentine, the young hacker Ed and Ein, an unusually clever corgi. A few days before Halloween on Mars, a tanker truck explodes on a highway, and people caught near the blast start falling ill from something in the smoke. The government puts a 300 million woolong bounty on whoever is responsible, and the crew, broke as usual, splits up to follow separate leads around the city. Shinichiro Watanabe directed this 2001 film, produced by Bones and Sunrise as a standalone story set during the TV series. It has some violence and mass casualties.

mahou-tsukai-no-yome-hoshi-matsu-hito.summary: Those Awaiting a Star is a three-part prequel told mostly in flashback. Chise Hatori lives in England as the apprentice of Elias Ainsworth, a non-human sorcerer with a skull-like animal head, when a parcel arrives from Angelica containing a picture book Chise knew as a child in Japan. When Elias asks about it, Chise tells him about a lonely stretch of her childhood, a mysterious library hidden in the woods and Miura, the librarian who looked after it. Wit Studio animated the episodes, which were bundled with volumes of Kore Yamazaki's manga between 2016 and 2017, ahead of the TV series. It touches on childhood loneliness and neglect.

nisekoi-2.summary: Raku Ichijo, heir to a yakuza family, and Chitoge Kirisaki, daughter of a rival gang's boss, are still pretending to be a couple so their families' gangs stay at peace, even though the two argue constantly. This second season picks up right after the first. Chitoge slowly realises her feelings for Raku are no longer an act, while Raku keeps hoping to identify the girl from his childhood whose key will open his locket. Kosaki Onodera, the classmate he has long liked, is still close by, and her younger sister Haru arrives at school with a very low opinion of him. Shaft adapted Naoshi Komi's manga into 12 episodes in 2015. It is a harem romantic comedy.

nanatsu-no-taizai-seisen-no-shirushi.summary: The Seven Deadly Sins, a band of outlaw knights, have helped Princess Elizabeth win back the Kingdom of Liones from the Holy Knights who seized it. In this four-episode follow-up, Meliodas, Elizabeth, the talking pig Hawk and the other Sins finally get some time to relax, and most of it goes on light side stories: inedible cooking, overdue rematches, an admirer who will not take the hint and a case of first love. Near the end, signs of a far larger danger begin to appear, setting up what comes next. A-1 Pictures aired the episodes in 2016, between the first and second seasons of its adaptation of Nakaba Suzuki's manga.

evangelion-1-0-you-are-not-alone.summary: Years after a global catastrophe, the fortified city of Tokyo-3 is being attacked by colossal beings known as Angels. Shinji Ikari, aged fourteen, is summoned there by Gendo, the father who abandoned him and now commands the secret organisation NERV, and is told to pilot Evangelion Unit-01, a giant machine built to fight them. Shinji has no training and every reason to refuse, but the only other option is sending the badly injured pilot Rei Ayanami out instead. Released by Studio Khara in 2007, this is the first of the four Rebuild of Evangelion films, a new version of the opening episodes of Neon Genesis Evangelion with Hideaki Anno as writer and chief director. It contains violence and psychological distress.

durarara-x2.summary: Ikebukuro, a busy Tokyo district full of street gangs, information brokers and urban legends, has calmed down after its last round of trouble. One of those legends is Celty Sturluson, a headless rider on a black motorcycle who works as a courier and is endlessly chased by the police. Then someone puts a large bounty on her, and gangs across the city start hunting her. Meanwhile quiet student Mikado Ryugamine gets a visit from Aoba Kuronuma, a younger boy who seems to know far too much about him, and a masked killer calling themselves Hollywood is loose. Shuka made these 12 episodes in 2015, the first of three parts of Durarara!!x2, based on Ryohgo Narita's light novels. It contains violence.

boku-wa-tomodachi-ga-sukunai-next.summary: Kodaka Hasegawa's hair and permanent scowl make people think he is a delinquent, so he has almost no friends. At school he belongs to the Neighbors Club, which the sharp-tongued Yozora Mikazuki set up so that people without friends could learn to make some, although its members, including the rich and arrogant Sena Kashiwazaki, mostly squabble. This second season carries on with their routine of games, outings, birthdays and preparations for the school festival, while new faces such as an odd nun and members of the student council join in and the feelings between club members slowly start to change. AIC Build adapted Yomi Hirasaka's light novels into 12 episodes in 2013. It includes frequent fan service.

fate-stay-night-movie-heaven-s-feel.summary: About ten years after a disaster in Fuyuki City, Shirou Emiya, raised by the man who rescued him from it, is pulled into the Holy Grail War: a secret contest in which seven mages and the heroic spirits they summon fight for a Grail said to grant any wish. This film follows the Heaven's Feel route of the original visual novel, which centres on Sakura Matou, a younger girl who has helped out at Shirou's home for years. As a mysterious shadow starts killing people across the city, Shirou joins forces with fellow master Rin Tohsaka. Ufotable released the film in 2017, directed by Tomonori Sudo, as the first part of a trilogy. It contains graphic violence and disturbing themes.

yakusoku-no-neverland-2nd-season.summary: Emma, Ray and the other older children have escaped Grace Field House, the orphanage they learned was really a farm raising children for demons to eat. Now they face an outside world they have never seen, full of strange plants and animals, with demons on their trail and several very young children to protect. Their only guidance comes from books by a mysterious figure called William Minerva, which hide messages about how to survive, and from a pen their friend Norman left behind. Emma is determined to one day return for the children still inside. CloverWorks produced the 11 episodes in 2021, based on Kaiu Shirai and Posuka Demizu's manga. It contains horror and violence.
yakusoku-no-neverland-2nd-season.notes: Wikipedia notes the season condenses and changes the manga's plot (original scenario supervised by Kaiu Shirai); left out of the summary because only one source states it.

spy-x-family-part-2.summary: Spy codename Twilight, posing as psychiatrist Loid Forger, has built a fake family to get close to politician Donovan Desmond: his adopted daughter Anya, secretly a mind reader, and his wife Yor, secretly an assassin, with none of them knowing the others' secrets. In this second half of the first season, Anya's first star at the elite Eden Academy earns her the dog she has been asking for. The search for one drags the family into a plot by university students to attack a foreign minister using bombs strapped to trained dogs, and Anya meets a gentle dog who can see the future. Wit Studio and CloverWorks made the 13 episodes in 2022 from Tatsuya Endo's manga.

spider-man-into-the-spider-verse.summary: Miles Morales is a Brooklyn teenager struggling with a new school and family expectations when a bite from a radioactive spider gives him powers like Spider-Man's. Before he can figure them out, he stumbles onto a super collider built by the crime boss Wilson 'Kingpin' Fisk, and its activation pulls Spider-people from other dimensions into his world, among them an older, worn-out Peter B. Parker. They need Miles's help to get home, and he needs them to learn what being Spider-Man actually means. Sony Pictures Animation released this American film in 2018, directed by Bob Persichetti, Peter Ramsey and Rodney Rothman. It is an action comedy with a comic-book visual style.
spider-man-into-the-spider-verse.notes: Not on MyAnimeList (American film); first source is the Kitsu entry. Premise also checked against the Letterboxd synopsis.

kamisama-hajimemashita-kako-hen.summary: High school girl Nanami Momozono became the land god of a small shrine, with the fox spirit Tomoe as her familiar. In these four episodes, Tomoe collapses while dark markings spread across his body, and Mikage, the shrine's former god, returns to explain: long before they met, Tomoe was cursed after making a deal in the hope of living as a human beside a woman he loved, and that curse has now woken again. With no cure available, Nanami decides to travel hundreds of years into the past to stop the curse from ever being placed. TMS Entertainment released the OVA episodes in 2015 and 2016, adapting the past arc of Julietta Suzuki's manga.

one-piece-film-z.summary: Monkey D. Luffy and the Straw Hat Pirates have entered the New World, the most dangerous stretch of the seas, on their hunt for the One Piece. There they cross paths with Z, a former Marine admiral who now leads his own force and wants to end the age of pirates altogether. Z has taken the Dyna Stones, weapons powerful enough to reshape the New World, and the Marines fear he will use them regardless of who gets hurt. The Straw Hats decide to go after him, and along the way meet both new faces and familiar ones. Toei Animation released the film in 2012, directed by Tatsuya Nagamine and based on Eiichiro Oda's manga.

the-last-naruto-the-movie.summary: Two years after the Fourth Great Ninja War, the Hidden Leaf Village is at peace and Kakashi Hatake serves as the Sixth Hokage. Then the moon begins to drift toward the Earth, and a mysterious figure named Toneri Otsutsuki kidnaps Hanabi, the younger sister of Hinata Hyuga. Naruto Uzumaki, now a young adult, sets out to rescue her with a small team of Sakura, Shikamaru, Sai and Hinata, and the mission also pushes Naruto to work out what Hinata, who has loved him for years, really means to him. Studio Pierrot released the 2014 film, directed by Tsuneo Kobayashi and based on Masashi Kishimoto's manga. It is an action film with a strong romantic thread.

inuyasha-kanketsu-hen.summary: Kagome Higurashi, a schoolgirl who can pass through an old well into feudal Japan, and the half-demon Inuyasha are still searching for the scattered shards of the Shikon Jewel, together with Miroku, a monk, Sango, a demon slayer, and Shippo, a young fox demon. Their enemy Naraku now holds most of the jewel and will sacrifice anyone, even his own creations, to complete it, while Inuyasha's half-brother Sesshomaru pursues him for his own reasons. The Final Act continues directly from the first TV series and adapts the remaining volumes of Rumiko Takahashi's manga in 26 episodes from Sunrise, aired in 2009 and 2010, with the original cast and staff returning. It contains fantasy violence.

nanatsu-no-taizai-imashime-no-fukkatsu-o.summary: This single OVA, known in English as Heroes' Frolic, came packaged with volume 34 of Nakaba Suzuki's manga in 2018. Instead of advancing the main plot, it gathers four short comedic side stories about the Seven Deadly Sins, the band of knights led by the cheerful Meliodas, and their friends in the Kingdom of Liones. One centres on Hawk, the talking pig who calls himself captain of the knights of leftovers, another on the fairy king Harlequin and his old friend Helbram, and the last follows the Sins on a vacation. A-1 Pictures animated it. It is a light comedic extra built around characters viewers already know.
nanatsu-no-taizai-imashime-no-fukkatsu-o.notes: The OVA's contents rest on the AniList segment list (Hawk, Harlequin and Helbram, a Sins vacation, 'Naked Heart') plus the MAL bundling note; no Wikipedia detail for this OVA.

kizumonogatari-part-3-reiketsu-hen.summary: Koyomi Araragi, a high school student, became a vampire and the servant of a legendary vampire, Kiss-shot Acerola-orion Heart-under-blade, when he saved her life during spring break. He has now fought the three vampire hunters who took her limbs and won them back, which means Kiss-shot will soon be at full power and able, she has promised, to turn him human again. With that moment close, Araragi starts to wonder what a fully restored Kiss-shot will do, while his classmate Tsubasa Hanekawa keeps trying to help him. Shaft released this final part of the Kizumonogatari film trilogy in 2017, based on Nisio Isin's light novel. It contains graphic violence, gore and fan service.

oreimo-season-2.summary: Kyousuke Kousaka is an ordinary high school student whose younger sister Kirino is a stylish model and track athlete with a secret love of anime and adult games aimed at men, and somehow he has ended up as her confidant. This second season begins with Kirino back home from a training stint in America, which Kyousuke talked her into abandoning. She is as cold to him as ever, he is not sure where they stand, and Kirino's friend Kuroneko leaves him a message he cannot decode. Relationships among the siblings and their friends start shifting toward romance. A-1 Pictures made 13 TV episodes and three web episodes in 2013 from Tsukasa Fushimi's light novels. It touches on sibling romance.

dragon-ball-gt.summary: Years after the events of Dragon Ball Z, Emperor Pilaf at last obtains the Black Star Dragon Balls, a stronger set than the usual kind. Goku interrupts him just as he makes his wish, and the botched result turns Goku back into a child. The Black Star Dragon Balls then scatter across the galaxy, and Goku learns that unless they are gathered within a year, Earth will be destroyed. He heads into space to find them, joined by Pan, his granddaughter, and a grown-up Trunks. Toei Animation produced the 64 episodes from 1996 to 1997 as an anime-only sequel that does not adapt Akira Toriyama's manga, though Toriyama designed some characters. It is an action adventure.

higurashi-no-naku-koro-ni-kai.summary: In the quiet mountain village of Hinamizawa, Keiichi Maebara and his friends, including the gentle shrine maiden Rika Furude, spend their days playing games together. In the first season, the village's annual festival kept being followed by murders and disappearances, told across several separate arcs that ended in tragedy. Kai is the answer half of the story: its arcs return to those events from new perspectives, explain what was really happening, and show Rika's long struggle to find out who is behind it all and change how things end. Studio Deen produced the 24 episodes in 2007, adapting the sound novels by Ryukishi07. It contains graphic violence, torture, suicide and psychological horror.

yosuga-no-sora-in-solitude-where-we-are-.summary: Orphaned by an accident that killed their mother and father, the twins Haruka and Sora Kasugano move back into their old family home in a quiet country town, where they lived until a few years earlier. Haruka is outgoing and quickly reconnects with people from his childhood, while Sora, frail and withdrawn, depends on him almost completely. The series is split into separate arcs, each following Haruka's relationship with a different girl in town, before telling the story of the twins themselves. Feel adapted the 2008 adult visual novel by CUFFS's Sphere brand into 12 episodes in 2010, directed by Takeo Takahashi. It contains explicit sexual content, including an incestuous relationship between the twins, and references to sexual assault.

the-world-god-only-knows-ii.summary: Keima Katsuragi is a high school student who has mastered every dating simulation game ever made but has no interest in real girls. After a contract with Elsie, a cheerful but clumsy demon from Hell, he is bound to help capture runaway evil spirits hiding in girls' hearts, and the only way to drive them out is to make each girl fall in love with him. This second season sends him after a new set of targets, including a karate club member and a student teacher, while Elsie's capable friend Haqua, another demon, arrives to help. Manglobe made the 12 episodes in 2011 from Tamiki Wakaki's manga. It is a romantic comedy that parodies dating sims.

violet-evergarden-special.summary: Violet Evergarden, who was raised as a soldier, now works as an Auto Memory Doll at the CH Postal Company, writing letters on behalf of clients. In this standalone episode she is hired by the celebrated opera singer Irma Felice to write a love letter. Irma gives her almost nothing to work with and asks Violet to rely on her own feelings instead, then turns down every draft. Violet asks her colleagues for help, and they write love letters of their own, with no better luck. To finish the job, she has to understand what Irma actually feels. Kyoto Animation released this extra episode in July 2018, set during the TV series and directed by Taichi Ishidate.

date-a-live-ii.summary: Spirits are beings from another world whose arrivals cause destructive spatial quakes, and most people want them eliminated. Shido Itsuka, an ordinary high school student, has an unusual alternative: by getting a Spirit to fall in love with him and kissing her, he can seal away her powers. Backed by Ratatoskr, a secret organisation run by his younger sister Kotori, he has already sealed three Spirits. This second season sends him on more high-stakes dates with new Spirits while a more powerful enemy begins to pay attention to Ratatoskr's work. Production IMS took over from AIC Plus+ for these 10 episodes in 2014, based on Koushi Tachibana's light novels. It mixes harem comedy, action and fan service.

rurouni-kenshin-tsuiokuhen.summary: Trust and Betrayal is a prequel to the Rurouni Kenshin TV series, set during the violent final years of the Tokugawa shogunate. Shinta, an orphan rescued from bandits by the swordmaster Hiko Seijuro and renamed Kenshin, grows into a gifted swordsman and leaves his master to join the rebel side. He becomes an assassin for the Choshu clan, known as Hitokiri Battousai, killing the shogunate's men in Kyoto. The four episodes show how he got the cross-shaped scar on his cheek and his relationship with a quiet woman named Tomoe Yukishiro. Studio Deen released the OVA in 1999, directed by Kazuhiro Furuhashi and based on Nobuhiro Watsuki's manga. It contains graphic, bloody violence.

gintama-enchousen.summary: Gintoki Sakata runs the Yorozuya, an odd-jobs business in an alternate Edo taken over by aliens, with his teenage assistant Shinpachi and the alien girl Kagura. Enchousen is the 13-episode extension of Gintama', aired by Sunrise from 2012 to 2013. It opens with Gintoki coming home to find a golden-haired lookalike named Kintoki running the Yorozuya, while nobody else seems to remember him. Then the trio head back to the pleasure district of Yoshiwara to help an elderly courtesan find the man she loved long ago, which leads into a more serious story about the district's past. The series is based on Hideaki Sorachi's manga and mixes parody and slapstick with occasional drama.

owarimonogatari.summary: In October of his final year of high school, Koyomi Araragi, a student who once became part vampire and has since dealt with many supernatural apparitions, meets Ougi Oshino, a new transfer student brought to him by his junior Suruga Kanbaru. Ougi wants his advice: on a map of the school she has drawn, she has found a classroom that should not exist. When the two end up shut inside it, Araragi realises the room is connected to something from his past that he had forgotten. The season's later arcs dig further into that history. Shaft adapted these chapters of Nisio Isin's Monogatari novels for TV in late 2015. It is dialogue-heavy, with mystery and supernatural elements.

tokyo-ghoul-re-2.summary: In a Tokyo where flesh-eating ghouls live hidden among humans, the Commission of Counter Ghoul (CCG) has become more powerful than ever. Haise Sasaki, the half-ghoul investigator who led the Quinx Squad, has resigned from that role and now takes on dangerous missions with an unsettling coldness, while memories of his former life as Ken Kaneki keep returning. The Quinx members, left without their mentor and dealing with a recent loss, try to carry on. Meanwhile, ghoul groups and the CCG both move toward a larger confrontation. Studio Pierrot produced these 12 episodes in 2018, the final season of the anime based on Sui Ishida's manga. It contains graphic violence, gore and cannibalism.

kimi-ni-todoke-2nd-season.summary: Sawako Kuronuma, a kind but painfully shy girl whose classmates once nicknamed her after a horror film ghost, has finally made real friends in Ayane Yano and Chizuru Yoshida. She has also realised she has feelings for Shota Kazehaya, the friendly, popular boy who first reached out to her. As Valentine's Day approaches, she cannot work out whether to give him chocolates, and the hesitation leaves Kazehaya feeling she is pulling away. Then the second school year starts, and a new classmate, Kento Miura, takes an interest in Sawako. Production I.G produced this second season in 2011, based on Karuho Shiina's manga. It is a slow, gentle romance.

dungeon-ni-deai-wo-motomeru-no-wa-machig.summary: In the city of Orario, adventurers serve gods in groups called Familias and explore the monster-filled Dungeon beneath it. Bell Cranel is the only adventurer in the tiny Hestia Familia, but he has gained a reputation as the fastest-rising newcomer in the city, helped by his supporter Lili and the smith Welf. That attention brings trouble: the god Apollo wants Bell for himself and declares war on Hestia's small Familia, even though his followers vastly outnumber hers. Later, a past debt catches up with Hestia and Lili's past returns to haunt her. J.C.Staff made the 12 episodes in 2019 from Fujino Omori's light novels. It mixes dungeon-crawling action with fan service.

toaru-kagaku-no-railgun-s.summary: Mikoto Misaka is one of the seven most powerful espers in Academy City, a city of students trained to develop psychic abilities, and is known as the Railgun for her electrical powers. In this second season, while she and her friends Kuroko, Kazari and Ruiko chase urban legends, Mikoto finds evidence of a horrifying research project: clones made from her own DNA, created to be killed in experiments. Believing she is partly to blame, she tries to stop it alone, which puts her in the path of some of the strongest espers in the city. J.C.Staff produced the 24 episodes in 2013, based on the manga by Kazuma Kamachi and Motoi Fuyukawa. It contains violence and dark themes.

toaru-majutsu-no-index-ii.summary: Touma Kamijou is an unlucky high school student in Academy City, a city of students trained to develop psychic powers, whose right hand, Imagine Breaker, cancels out any supernatural power it touches, esper or magical. Since he met Index, a young nun who carries 103,000 forbidden grimoires in her memory, he has been dragged into one clash after another between the city and the hidden world of magic. In this second season the friction between the two sides grows, and Touma takes on both espers and magicians across a run of separate arcs, with old allies and new rivals involved. J.C.Staff made the 24 episodes in 2010 and 2011 from Kazuma Kamachi's light novels. It contains action violence.

kakeguruixx.summary: At Hyakkaou Private Academy, an elite school for the children of the wealthy, a student's standing depends on how well they gamble, and the student council runs the system. Yumeko Jabami, a transfer student who gambles for the thrill of the risk rather than to win, has shaken that order. In this second season, council president Kirari Momobami announces an election for her successor: every student gets one chip, and whoever holds the most after thirty days becomes president and head of the powerful Momobami clan. Branch members of the family arrive as transfer students to compete. MAPPA produced the 12 episodes in 2019 from the manga by Homura Kawamoto and Toru Naomura. It contains violence, cruelty and sexualised imagery.

kiss-x-sis-tv.summary: Keita Suminoe is a middle school student studying hard to get into the same high school as his older twin stepsisters, Ako and Riko. The problem is that both of them are openly in love with him and keep competing for his attention with increasingly forward advances, while Keita struggles to sort out how he feels about them. Other girls around him take an interest too, adding to the chaos at home and at school. Feel adapted Bow Ditama's manga into 12 TV episodes in 2010, alongside a longer-running OVA series. It is an ecchi romantic comedy with heavy sexual content and step-sibling romance throughout.

gargantia-on-the-verdurous-planet.summary: In the distant future, most of humanity has left Earth behind, and its interstellar Alliance is fighting a long war against monstrous creatures called the Hideauze. Ledo, a 16-year-old Alliance soldier, is thrown through space during a battle and wakes up with his talking mech Chamber on a forgotten planet: Earth, now almost entirely covered by ocean. He is taken in by Gargantia, a huge fleet of salvage ships whose people live by scavenging the sea, and has to learn their language and way of life, starting with Amy, a cheerful messenger girl. Production I.G made the original 13-episode series in 2013, directed by Kazuya Murata. It is a science fiction story about culture shock and adjustment.

kizumonogatari-part-2-nekketsu-hen.summary: During spring break, high school student Koyomi Araragi saved a dying vampire by offering her his blood, and woke up as a vampire himself. Her name is Kiss-shot Acerola-orion Heart-under-blade, and three hunters have taken her limbs: Dramaturgy, who is a vampire too; Episode, a half-vampire able to become mist; and Guillotinecutter, a priest and fully human. Kiss-shot has promised to make Araragi human again once she is whole, so he sets out to fight each of them and get her limbs back, with help from his classmate Tsubasa Hanekawa. Shaft released this second part of the Kizumonogatari film trilogy in 2016, based on Nisio Isin's light novel. It contains graphic violence, gore and fan service.

mahou-shoujo-madoka-magica-movie-3-hangy.summary: Rebellion is an original sequel to Puella Magi Madoka Magica. In the city of Mitakihara, Madoka Kaname, Sayaka Miki, Mami Tomoe and Kyoko Sakura live cheerful school lives and fight together as magical girls against creatures called Nightmares. Homura Akemi has recently joined them. Everything seems almost too peaceful, and Homura begins to feel that something about this world is wrong, even though the others notice nothing. She sets out to find what lies behind it. Shaft released the film in 2013, with the original TV series' main staff, including writer Gen Urobuchi, returning. Viewers should watch the TV series first. It contains violence and disturbing psychological themes.

jujutsu-kaisen-movie-0.summary: Yuta Okkotsu is a timid high school student haunted by Rika Orimoto, his childhood friend who died young and now clings to him as a monstrous curse, lashing out at anyone who hurts him. Afraid of what she might do, Yuta is ready to give up, until Satoru Gojo, a powerful sorcerer and teacher, brings him to Tokyo Jujutsu High, a school for people who fight curses. There he trains with classmates Maki Zenin, Toge Inumaki and Panda while learning to control Rika's power. MAPPA released the film in 2021, directed by Sunghoo Park and based on Gege Akutami's prequel manga to Jujutsu Kaisen. It contains graphic violence.

boku-no-hero-academia-the-movie-3.summary: In a world where most people have superpowers called Quirks, an extremist group called Humarise believes Quirk users are a disease and plans to wipe them out with Trigger Bombs, devices that cause Quirks to spiral out of control. Pro heroes are sent around the world to stop them, and the students of U.A. High go along. Izuku Midoriya, on assignment in the country of Otheon, is framed for a crime and ends up on the run with Rody Soul, a local boy who makes a living however he can. Bones released this third My Hero Academia film in 2021, directed by Kenji Nagasaki, with an original story credited to manga creator Kohei Horikoshi. It contains action violence.

dragon-ball-super-broly.summary: Decades ago on Planet Vegeta, King Vegeta saw that a baby named Broly had greater latent power than his own son and exiled the infant to the barren planet Vampa. Broly's father Paragus followed him there, but a damaged ship left the two stranded for years. In the present, Goku and Vegeta, believed to be among the last Saiyans, are training on Earth when the hunt for the Dragon Balls draws them into a confrontation with Broly, whose strength is unlike anything they have faced. The film also revisits the last days of the Saiyan homeworld. Toei Animation released it in 2018, directed by Tatsuya Nagamine, with Akira Toriyama writing the screenplay. It is a fight-focused action film.

yahari-ore-no-seishun-love-comedy-wa-mac.summary: Hachiman Hikigaya, a cynical loner, spends his school days in the Service Club with the sharp, aloof Yukino Yukinoshita and the warm, sociable Yui Yuigahama, helping other students with their problems while avoiding his own. In this third and final season, Yukino decides she wants to stand on her own and repair things with her family, and she sees a chance to prove herself when student council president Iroha Isshiki asks the club to help put on a graduation prom for the third-years. Preparations for the event, and the unspoken feelings between the three, come to a head. Feel produced the 12 episodes in 2020, adapting Wataru Watari's light novels. It is a dialogue-heavy romantic drama.

zero-no-tsukaima-futatsuki-no-kishi.summary: Louise Francoise de La Valliere, a noble mage-in-training once mocked as Louise the Zero, summoned an ordinary Japanese teenager, Saito Hiraga, as her familiar, and the two are now treated as heroes after defending the Kingdom of Tristain. In this second season, Louise has discovered a gift for Void, a rare and dangerous kind of magic, while the newly crowned Queen Henrietta faces political trouble and a hidden enemy plots against the crown. Louise and Saito are pushed back into service, still bickering constantly as their feelings for each other grow. J.C.Staff made the 12 episodes in 2007 from Noboru Yamaguchi's light novels. It is a fantasy romantic comedy with frequent fan service.

redline.summary: Every five years the galaxy holds the Redline, an anything-goes car race that is as famous as it is dangerous. JP, a reckless daredevil driver, finally gets a place in it, as does Sonoshee McLaren, a promising young racer who, like him, is human. This time, the course runs through Roboworld, a militarised planet whose government has threatened to destroy anyone who sets foot in it, so the competitors face soldiers and heavy weapons on top of each other. Madhouse released the film in 2009, directed by Takeshi Koike from an original story by Katsuhito Ishii. It contains action violence.

k-on-movie.summary: Yui Hirasawa, Mio Akiyama, Ritsu Tainaka and Tsumugi Kotobuki are about to graduate from high school, along with the Light Music Club they formed and their younger bandmate Azusa Nakano, who will be left behind. With only a few weeks left, the friends decide to take a graduation trip abroad and, after much debate, end up in London. There they see the sights, get lost, eat a great deal and end up performing for local audiences, while the seniors think about how to say goodbye to Azusa. Kyoto Animation released the film in 2011, directed by Naoko Yamada, with an original story based on kakifly's manga. It is a gentle comedy about friendship.

black-butler-ii.summary: In Victorian England, Alois Trancy is the young head of the Trancy household, a temperamental earl who says he was kidnapped and enslaved as a child before being returned home just before his father died. Not everyone believes him, and the Trancy mansion has its own secrets, starting with Claude Faustus, a butler in black with powers no human should have. As Alois's path crosses with Ciel Phantomhive, the boy earl of a rival house, and his demon butler Sebastian Michaelis, the two households are drawn into a dangerous conflict. A-1 Pictures made the 12 episodes in 2010 as an anime-original story using characters from Yana Toboso's manga. It contains violence and dark themes.

sword-art-online-alternative-gun-gale-on.summary: Karen Kohiruimaki, a reserved college student living in Tokyo, has always been self-conscious about her height. Looking for an escape, she tries one virtual reality game after another until Gun Gale Online gives her the tiny, cute avatar she always wanted. As LLENN, a little player dressed in pink, she becomes a feared hunter of other players. After a fight she loses, she meets Pitohui, an eccentric and highly skilled player who becomes her friend and pushes her to enter Squad Jam, a tournament where teams fight until one is left. Studio 3Hz adapted Keiichi Sigsawa's spin-off novels set in the Sword Art Online universe created by Reki Kawahara into 12 episodes in 2018. It contains gun violence.

gate-jieitai-kanochi-nite-kaku-tatakaeri.summary: A mysterious gate opened in Tokyo's Ginza district and an army from another world poured through. Japan's Self-Defense Forces drove it back and crossed into the fantasy realm on the other side, known as the Special Region. Months later, peace talks with the realm's Empire are stalling, other nations on Earth are eyeing its resources, and Princess Pina Co Lada struggles to convince her father that Japan does not want conquest. Lieutenant Youji Itami, an easygoing otaku officer, and the girls who follow him are caught up in the court politics. A-1 Pictures made this second 12-episode cour in 2016 from Takumi Yanai's novels. It contains war violence.

tamako-love-story.summary: Tamako Kitashirakawa, whose family runs a mochi shop in a small shopping street, is nearing the end of high school with no plans beyond the business and her baton club. Her neighbour and childhood friend Mochizou Ooji, whose family runs the rival shop across the street, has loved her for years without telling her, and he now plans to go to university in Tokyo. As his departure gets closer, he has to work up the courage to finally say something. Kyoto Animation released the film in 2014 as a sequel to the TV series Tamako Market, directed by Naoko Yamada. It is a quiet coming-of-age romance.

rezero-season-2-part-2.summary: Subaru Natsuki was pulled into a fantasy world with one strange ability: when he dies, he returns to an earlier moment, keeping his memories while nobody else does. In this second half of season two he is still stuck in the Sanctuary, a secluded village bound by a barrier and a set of trials. After a blunt talk from his friend Otto Suwen, he resolves to get through this loop and save everyone he can. The first step is helping Emilia, the half-elf he has sworn to protect, face her own past, though she feels everyone has lied to her. White Fox made the 12 episodes in 2021 from Tappei Nagatsuki's light novels. It contains graphic violence and psychological distress.

jujutsu-kaisen-2.summary: Season two of Jujutsu Kaisen is split into two stories. The first goes back to 2006, when Satoru Gojo and Suguru Geto were cocky, inseparable students at Tokyo Jujutsu High and among the strongest sorcerers alive, and follows a mission to protect a girl named Riko Amanai that tests both their friendship and their beliefs. The second returns to 2018, where Yuji Itadori, a teenager who carries the cursed spirit Sukuna inside him, and his fellow students are drawn into an all-out clash between sorcerers and curses in Shibuya on Halloween night. MAPPA produced the 23 episodes in 2023 from Gege Akutami's manga. It contains graphic violence, gore and the deaths of major characters.

hunter-x-hunter-ova.summary: This eight-episode OVA continues the 1999 Hunter x Hunter TV series from where it stopped, in the middle of the Yorknew City arc. Kurapika, the last survivor of the Kurta clan, has finally taken revenge on part of the Phantom Troupe, the band of thieves known as the Spiders who wiped out his people, and believes their leader is dead. Then word arrives that the Spiders are still alive. Gon, Killua and Leorio decide to help him, and the group plan to go after the Troupe member whose ability is the greatest danger to Kurapika. Nippon Animation released the episodes in 2002, based on Yoshihiro Togashi's manga. It contains violence.
hunter-x-hunter-ova.notes: Plot points rest on MAL/Kitsu synopsis (shared text) plus the 1999-series context on Wikipedia; Wikipedia does not describe the OVA's story in detail.

ghost-in-the-shell-stand-alone-complex-2.summary: After the Laughing Man case, Public Security Section 9 has been brought back by Yoko Kayabuki, Japan's new prime minister, to deal with cyber-terrorism. Major Motoko Kusanagi, Batou, Togusa and Chief Aramaki now face the Individual Eleven, a group behind a string of terrorist attacks across the country. At the same time, Japan is struggling with millions of refugees displaced by world war, whose demands for rights are pushing the country toward unrest, and the team keeps crossing paths with Kazundo Gouda, a senior figure in the Cabinet Intelligence Service. Production I.G made the 26 episodes in 2004 and 2005, directed by Kenji Kamiyama from Masamune Shirow's manga. It contains violence.

kaze-no-stigma.summary: Kazuma Yagami was thrown out of the Kannagi family, a powerful clan of fire users, four years ago because he could not use fire and lost a duel to his younger cousin Ayano. He returns to the family home as a master of wind magic, just as several Kannagi members have been killed by someone using wind. The family, and especially the hot-tempered Ayano, suspect him, and he has to clear his name while reluctantly helping the people who cast him out. Kazuma and Ayano keep clashing as they end up working together on supernatural cases. Gonzo adapted Takahiro Yamato's light novels into 24 episodes in 2007. It is a supernatural action series with comedy.

kimetsu-no-yaiba-katanakaji-no-satohen.summary: Tanjiro Kamado is a demon slayer travelling with his younger sister Nezuko, who was turned into a demon but has never attacked a human. After his sword is damaged beyond use, Tanjiro is taken to the Swordsmith Village, a hidden settlement of master smiths whose location the Demon Slayer Corps guards carefully, to have a new one made. There he meets two Hashira, the Corps' strongest fighters: the distant, forgetful Mist Hashira Muichiro Tokito and the warm-hearted Love Hashira Mitsuri Kanroji. Meanwhile, the demons are reorganising, and danger is closing in on the village. Ufotable made these 11 episodes in 2023 from Koyoharu Gotouge's manga. It contains graphic violence.

owarimonogatari-2nd-season.summary: Koyomi Araragi, in his final year of high school, once became part vampire and has spent the past year dealing with apparitions, the supernatural beings behind many of his friends' troubles. After a meeting with Izuko Gaen, an expert on apparitions who seems to know everything, he wakes up in a strange, empty place and finds a familiar face waiting there. With help from his girlfriend Hitagi Senjougahara, Araragi tries to make sense of his past and present, and is drawn once more toward Ougi Oshino, the transfer student who seems to know too much. Shaft aired these seven episodes over two nights in August 2017, adapting Nisio Isin's novels. It is a dialogue-heavy supernatural mystery.

one-piece-strong-world.summary: When news reaches the Straw Hat Pirates that islands in the East Blue, where Monkey D. Luffy started his journey, are being destroyed, they set off to investigate. On the way they run into Shiki, the Golden Lion, a legendary pirate who escaped the great prison Impel Down and can make objects float. Shiki kidnaps their navigator Nami to sail for him and scatters the rest of the crew across his floating islands, a strange land under his complete control. Luffy and the others have to survive and get her back. Toei Animation released the 2009 film, directed by Munehisa Sakai and based on Eiichiro Oda's manga, as the tenth One Piece film.

the-world-god-only-knows-goddess-arc.summary: Keima Katsuragi, a master of dating sims who has no interest in real girls, has spent two seasons capturing runaway spirits by getting girls to fall for him, under a contract with the demon Elsie. Now he learns that a group of goddesses once sealed away Old Hell, and that some of them are hiding inside girls he has already won over, who no longer remember him. Diana, the goddess living in his childhood friend Tenri Ayukawa, asks him to find her sisters, which means winning those girls' hearts a second time. Manglobe made the 12 episodes in 2013 from Tamiki Wakaki's manga. It is a romantic comedy.

violet-evergarden-gaiden-eien-to-jidou-s.summary: Violet Evergarden, an Auto Memory Doll who writes letters for others, is sent by the royal family of Drossel to a prestigious girls' boarding school. Her assignment is to tutor Isabella York, the daughter of a noble family, ahead of her formal debut in society, while posing as her maid. Isabella sees the school as a cage and treats Violet coldly at first, assuming she has had an easy life. As the two grow closer, Violet learns that Isabella's past holds poverty and a painful separation, and with the help of her colleague Benedict she uses letters to reconnect Isabella with it. Kyoto Animation released this side-story film in 2019, directed by Haruka Fujita.

fruits-basket-2nd-season.summary: Tohru Honda, an orphaned high school girl, has lived with members of the Soma family for a year and knows their secret: several of them are possessed by the spirits of the Chinese zodiac and turn into animals when hugged by someone of the opposite sex. She has helped many of them, but the closer she gets, the clearer it becomes that the curse hides something darker than she imagined. In this second season she spends the summer with the Somas, especially the bickering cousins Yuki and Kyo, and meets more of the family. TMS Entertainment made the 25 episodes in 2020, the second season of its adaptation of Natsuki Takaya's manga. It touches on abuse and trauma.

blood.summary: Saya Otonashi is a high school girl in Okinawa who lives with the family that adopted her. She seems ordinary apart from anaemia and the fact that she remembers nothing from before the past year. One night at school a blood-drinking monster attacks her. A silent man named Haji steps in, makes her drink his blood, and Saya suddenly fights with a skill she did not know she had. She learns that she is linked to these creatures, the Chiropterans, and that a secret organisation called the Red Shield wants her help to wipe them out. Production I.G made the original 50-episode series in 2005 and 2006, directed by Junichi Fujisaku. It contains graphic violence and gore.

sword-of-the-stranger.summary: In Sengoku-era Japan, an orphan boy named Kotaro survives by stealing, with his dog Tobimaru for company. For reasons he does not understand, he is being hunted by a band of skilled swordsmen sent from Ming China. When Tobimaru is poisoned during an attack, Kotaro crosses paths with a nameless ronin hiding out in an abandoned temple, a foreign-born swordsman who has sworn never to draw his blade again. Kotaro offers him a jewel to act as his bodyguard, and the reluctant ronin agrees. Bones released the original film in 2007, directed by Masahiro Ando. It is a samurai action drama with graphic, bloody swordfights.

mawaru-penguindrum.summary: Twin brothers Kanba and Shoma Takakura live alone with their younger sister Himari, who is seriously ill. On a day out at the aquarium, Himari collapses, and is then revived by a penguin-shaped hat from the gift shop, which takes over her body and tells the brothers she will stay alive only if they find something called the Penguindrum. Helped by a trio of strange penguins, the brothers start trailing a girl named Ringo Oginome, whose diary may be the key. Brain's Base produced the original 24 episodes in 2011, directed by Kunihiko Ikuhara. It is surreal and symbolic, and deals with trauma and a terror attack.

sayonara-zetsubou-sensei.summary: Nozomu Itoshiki teaches at a high school and sees disaster in everything; the smallest setback sends him into despair, and he regularly announces that he wants to die. His class is just as strange: a shut-in girl who lives inside the school building, a student who always turns up with mysterious injuries, a relentlessly positive girl who sees the bright side of everything, and many others. Each episode uses their exchanges to satirise modern Japanese society, current events and social habits. Shaft adapted Kouji Kumeta's manga into 12 episodes in 2007, directed by Akiyuki Shinbo, with a busy visual style full of on-screen text jokes. It is a dark comedy that jokes heavily about suicide.

megalo-box.summary: Megalo Box is boxing in which fighters wear mechanical Gear to boost the power and speed of their punches. In the slums outside a gleaming city, a fighter called Junk Dog boxes in illegal underground matches, mostly losing on purpose when his trainer Gansaku Nanbu, who owes gangsters money, says so. Then Yuri, the reigning champion, enters Junk Dog's ring disguised as an ordinary challenger and beats him easily. Wanting a rematch, Junk Dog sets out to enter Megalonia, the top tournament, even though he has no legal identity. TMS Entertainment made the 13 episodes in 2018, directed by You Moriyama, as a tribute marking 50 years of Ashita no Joe, the classic boxing manga. It contains violence.

teen-titans.summary: Five teenage superheroes live together in Titans Tower, a giant T-shaped building on an island off the coast of their city: Robin, the team's driven leader; Starfire, a warm-hearted alien princess; Cyborg, a half-machine strongman; Raven, a reserved girl with dark magical powers; and Beast Boy, a joker who can turn into any animal. They fight a steady stream of villains, chief among them the masked mastermind Slade, while dealing with friendship, growing up and their own pasts. Glen Murakami created the American series for Cartoon Network, based on the DC Comics team, and it ran for five seasons and 65 episodes from 2003 to 2006. It is a superhero action comedy with an anime-influenced style.
teen-titans.notes: Not on MyAnimeList (American series); first source is the Kitsu entry.

evangelion-3-0-you-can-not-redo.summary: Shinji Ikari wakes up inside Evangelion Unit-01 to find that fourteen years have passed in a single moment for him. The Earth is in ruins, the people he knew have changed beyond recognition, and he is held by WILLE, a military group under Misato Katsuragi, who once looked after him, whose crew, including Asuka and Mari, treat him with suspicion and coldness. Confused and hurt, Shinji is taken back to NERV by Rei, and meets Kaworu Nagisa there. Released by Studio Khara in 2012, this is the third of the four Rebuild of Evangelion films, with Hideaki Anno as chief director, telling a new story that departs from the TV series. It contains violence and psychological distress.

tsukimonogatari.summary: Koyomi Araragi is preparing for university entrance exams when he notices something alarming: he no longer has a reflection in the mirror. Ever since he was turned into a vampire and only partly recovered, he has relied on vampire abilities shared with Shinobu Oshino, who lives in his shadow, and that habit now seems to be catching up with him.
